text.firstObservation: The thunderback holds the jungle edge above the river landing the way a boar holds a wallow: head low, weight already forward, waiting for something to come far enough down the bank to be worth crossing the ground for.

art.framing: Entire animal, snout, all four feet, target line and charge lane remain inside the battle safe frame.

open.level: needs decision: Habitats::black_beach_vertical_slice carries no level for this creature. habitat.black_beach.river_jungle's base_level 7 is a region level, not a creature level -- the tideline is base_level 5 and its razorbeak is level 7 -- so reading it as this creature's level would invent a number.
open.stats.vitality: needs decision: no authored or fixture source carries a vitality for the thunderback.
open.stats.guard: needs decision: no authored or fixture source carries a guard value for the thunderback.
open.stats.initiative: needs decision: no authored or fixture source carries an initiative for the thunderback.
open.skillIds: needs decision: HabitatRecord.intent_suite belongs to the habitat, not to its holder -- habitat.black_beach.tideline advertises only rushing_bite while enemy.raptor.razorbeak declares two skills -- so the river jungle's suite cannot be read as this creature's skill list, and no other source names one.

notes: Everything decided here is read from Habitats::black_beach_vertical_slice: the creature is a Beast on habitat.black_beach.river_jungle's roster from day 1 and not night-only, the habitat spawns one individual per day (daily_count 1) and is return_eligible, and its drop is content/loot/thunderback.prototype.json, whose display name is Thunderback Salvage.
stats.startingBand is 2 in every authored enemy record, which is Band::EnemyFront -- structure, not tuning -- so it is authored rather than left open.
Unlike enemy.raptor.razorbeak.crested this record derives from nothing: the thunderback is not a variant of any authored creature, so there is no base whose numbers it could honestly take.
